description: §40.8 (S443, ruled) — two top-level `<program>` elements in ONE file fire E-PROGRAM-002. Before S443 the second program's `auth=` was silently ignored (compute-program-config reads only the first), so its routes served anonymous callers (g-two-top-level-programs-one-file-second-auth-dropped).
rationale: §40.8 'declare its top-level `<program>` element exactly ONCE'; bryan S443 (user-voice item 3): E-PROGRAM-002 covers the same-file case.
